# REMAINING WORK — Unified Movie Integration and Proof

The Awtsmoos renews every frame in time; Awtsmoos.com asks that many studios share one grammar and still each rhyme.

## Mission
Turn the currently competing movie implementations into one canonical AI-authorable movie protocol, preserve app-specific strengths, connect every relevant movie-capable surface, render a real 180-second feature proof, and close only with runtime evidence.

## Evidence already observed
- Animator is the strongest procedural 2D/3D generation and camera surface.
- Nesher Studio is the strongest NLE/export/timeline surface.
- Video Editor is a lighter timeline/caption editing surface.
- Mitzvah Studio is an object/shape/text authoring surface useful for movie construction.
- `apps/shared/movie` models seconds, explicit 2D/3D/hybrid layer kinds, cameras, keyframes and already contains a 180-second example.
- `shared/movie` models milliseconds and separately describes Video Editor/Mitzvah capabilities.
- `libs/awtsmoos-movie-core` is a third partial contract.
- Existing Animator prompt-to-scene logic was observed to be hard-coded rather than genuinely arbitrary.

## Remaining graph
1. Freeze a fresh snapshot of all competing cores and active adapter writes.
2. Choose one canonical public protocol and document unit semantics.
3. Make AI capability discovery describe all participating apps.
4. Ensure arbitrary movie duration, not 60/120-second special cases.
5. Ensure narrative, tutorial, infographic, characters, shapes, paths, particles, text, 2D, 3D, hybrid and camera motion are representable.
6. Give Animator, Nesher, Video Editor and Mitzvah truthful canonical adapters.
7. Preserve unsupported semantic layers through fidelity reports instead of deleting them.
8. Preserve compatibility for alternate cores rather than leaving three contradictory public truths.
9. Add a deterministic structured-intent compiler that never pretends a local LLM exists.
10. Improve the mobile-first AI dock with duration, dimension, intent/import and injected-AI hooks.
11. Validate the three-minute example is exactly 180 seconds and feature-dense.
12. Render the canonical movie through a real browser/canvas/video path.
13. Measure duration, dimensions, codec/container and nontrivial output size.
14. Capture distant frame witnesses proving scene and camera diversity.
15. Syntax-check every touched JS file and run contract/adapter/browser smoke tests.
16. Re-read every touched file and compare planned versus actual.
17. Resolve every discovered delta or record a hard blocker with evidence.
18. Leave REMAINING_WORK empty only when verification evidence closes the graph.
